headline: BTC stalls below $78k as liquidity hunt tests key support
btc_thesis: On the 1H chart BTC is forming a descending channel, holding the 77,000 support while probing the 78,200 resistance; the 4H shows a higher‑time swing low at 76,500 acting as a liquidity buffer.
altcoin_summary: Altcoins are rotating into high‑beta assets, with ACE, SC, ONG and FF leading gains as capital seeks upside after Bitcoin's pullback.
strategy_outlook: Enter spot BTC near 77,000 with a tight stop below 76,800; on futures, consider short‑biased scalps targeting the 78,200 ceiling while respecting the same stop.
